_comment: Cache of resolved Figma page/frame names to node IDs, maintained by the figma-sync skill. Read first on every invocation so a name only ever needs live discovery (or a pasted URL) once. Figma's 'list pages' endpoint can lag behind newly-added pages/frames, so this file is the source of truth for names already seen, even when the live listing hasn't caught up yet. If a cached ID ever 404s (node deleted/moved), remove that entry, re-resolve, and rewrite it.
